statement: Combining neuron-intrinsic growth activation, a growth-supportive substrate and chemoattraction regrew propriospinal axons across a complete spinal cord transection in rodents, which no single component achieved.

context.intervention: growth activation plus substrate plus chemoattractant

measurement.effect: robust regrowth across the lesion with the combination only

evidence.note: neural stem cell grafts supporting long-distance growth after severe injury

replication.note: Two reports from overlapping Californian groups (Sofroniew; Tuszynski).

limitations: regrowth demonstrated anatomically; functional benefit is the open question

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
